releaseNotes:
OmniControl Suite v6.5.1 Universal Live Feature Indications & Diagnostic Warning Badges:
- Card Live Status Badges: Every feature card across all 9 views now displays dynamic status pills indicating ON (Emerald Green), STANDBY (Slate Gray), RESTRICTED (Amber Gold), or UNSUPPORTED (Ruby Red).
- AI Agent Mesh Live Indicators: All 8 specialized AI agents display real-time active dots and status tags.
- Hardware & Permission Warning Guards: Instantly warns if permissions or hardware features are disabled or locked.
- Standalone Single-File Executable published directly to Desktop and GitHub.
